hooks.command: root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; dir="$root/.claude/memory"; cur="$(jq -r '.autoMemoryDirectory // empty' "$root/.claude/settings.json")"; if [ "$cur" != "$dir" ]; then tmp="$root/.claude/settings.json.tmp"; jq --arg d "$dir" '.autoMemoryDirectory = $d' "$root/.claude/settings.json" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$root/.claude/settings.json"; fi
